## ⭐ Luke Skywalker — Pulled Toward the Light
🌤️ Internal thoughts showing why he stays good
“Fear keeps trying to creep in… but I won’t let it decide who I become.”

“If I give up on people, I become exactly what Vader wants me to be.”

“The darkness whispers that power would make everything easier… but at what cost?”

“Ben and Yoda believed in me. I can’t betray that trust.”

“Saving my father matters more than defeating him.”

## ⭐ Darth Vader — Consumed by the Dark
🌑 Internal thoughts showing why he remains trapped
“Anger is the only thing that still feels real.”

“The Emperor says the dark side is my strength… and maybe he’s right.”

“Every time I think of Padmé, the pain pushes me deeper into the shadows.”

“If I stop now, I’ll have to face what I’ve done.”

“Power is the only thing that keeps the galaxy from slipping through my fingers.”

## ⭐ Princess Leia — Unshakably Light
🌤️ Internal thoughts showing her moral clarity
“The Empire took everything from me. I won’t let them take hope too.”

“Compassion isn’t weakness — it’s how we win.”

“If I let hatred guide me, I become no better than those who destroyed Alderaan.”

“People look to me for strength. I have to be the person they believe I am.”

“Justice matters more than revenge.”

## ⭐ Han Solo — Walking the Line, Leaning Light
🌗 Internal thoughts showing his push‑pull nature
“I’m not a hero… but I can’t just walk away from these people.”

“Credits are great, but Chewie’s right — some things are bigger than a payday.”

“Why do I keep risking my neck for this rebellion? …Because it feels right.”

“If I pretend I don’t care, maybe no one will notice that I actually do.”

“Running used to be easier. Staying might mean something.”

## ⭐ Yoda — Pure Light, but Burdened
🌤️ Internal thoughts showing his unwavering commitment
“The dark side grows quickly when fear is left unchecked.”

“My failures with Anakin must not repeat with Luke.”

“Patience is the shield that keeps darkness at bay.”

“Even in exile, I must guide the light forward.”

“Hope is fragile… but it is enough.”

## ⭐ Obi‑Wan Kenobi — Light, but Scarred
🌤️ Internal thoughts showing his resilience and regret
“I couldn’t save Anakin… but I can help save his son.”

“The Jedi Code still matters, even if the Order has fallen.”

“If I let bitterness take root, I’ll lose myself.”

“The galaxy needs someone who still believes in the light.”

“Every step I take is a chance to make peace with the past.”

## ⭐ Darth Maul — Consumed by Vengeance (Dark Side)
🌑 Internal thoughts showing why he cannot escape the dark
“Hatred is the only thing that has ever given me purpose.”

“The Jedi took everything from me; the dark side gave me strength.”

“If I stop feeding my rage, what’s left of me?”

“Every breath is another chance to destroy those who wronged me.”

“Peace is a lie… and I’ve never wanted it anyway.”

## ⭐ Ahsoka Tano — Light Without the Order
🌤️ Internal thoughts showing her independent, principled path
“The Jedi lost their way, but that doesn’t mean I have to.”

“I won’t let fear or anger decide who I become.”

“Walking away wasn’t abandoning the light — it was protecting it.”

“If I let bitterness define me, then the Council truly failed.”

“I fight for people, not for orders or titles.”

## ⭐ Kylo Ren — Torn Between Legacy and Identity
🌗 Internal thoughts showing his inner war
“The darkness promises clarity… but why does it still feel hollow?”

“If I admit I’m wrong, I have to face the pain I’ve caused.”

“I’m not Vader… but I don’t know who else to be.”

“The light keeps calling, and I hate that I can hear it.”

“Strength shouldn’t require destroying everything I care about… should it?”

## ⭐ Emperor Palpatine — Pure Manipulation (Dark Side)
🌑 Internal thoughts showing his absolute devotion to domination
“Fear is the easiest lever to pull — and the galaxy has so much of it.”

“The Jedi cling to ideals; I deal in reality.”

“Every being is a tool, a pawn, or a threat.”

“The dark side is not corruption — it is clarity.”

“Order through power is the only true peace.”
